content.short: Non-custodial institutional staking provider running validators on 40+ networks.
content.description: Luganodes runs validators for institutions and individuals on Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Sui, Hyperliquid, Monad and dozens more, with more than $2 billion staked and 99.9% uptime. It is certified to ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II, had its slashing risk reviewed by Quantstamp, and offers insurance through Chainproof at no extra cost. Stakers keep custody of their assets throughout.
content.meta: Stake on 40+ networks with Luganodes, a SOC 2 certified non-custodial validator with $2B+ staked and optional insurance.
